_meta.coverage_note: The Federal Register full-text archive begins in 1994. TPS was created by the Immigration Act of 1990, so designations made in 1991-1993 (including the original El Salvador designation) are not retrievable from this API and are NOT represented here. This dataset is complete from 1994-01-01 forward.
_meta.method: Every row is a Federal Register document. Country and action are read from the document title only -- no amounts, dates, or outcomes are inferred. Documents that mention TPS only in the body (fee schedules, forms notices) are excluded.
_meta.CRITICAL_publication_is_not_legal_effect: This dataset records what DHS PUBLISHED, not what is currently in force. A published termination can be vacated, enjoined by a court, or superseded -- Venezuela's 2025 record contains a vacatur (90 FR 8805) two days before a termination (90 FR 9040), and several terminations in this file have been litigated. NEVER render a row as 'TPS for X has ended.' Render it as 'DHS published a termination notice on <date> (<FR cite>)' and link the litigation status. Current status comes from the USCIS TPS page and our case tracker, never from this file alone.
